packages/adapters/src/runs/wakeups/wakes.name: Wake prompts
packages/adapters/src/runs/wakeups/wakes.description: Holds the canned prompts that resume a run when a ticket, purchase, video or cloud agent changes status.

packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-t.name: Routine event triggers
packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-t.description: Validates webhook, Git, chat and email trigger settings for a bot and stores its webhook key.

packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-t.name: Trigger prompt notes
packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-t.description: Holds the notes telling a bot where users find webhook keys and that a chat trigger replaces normal replies.

packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-c.name: Timer tick coalescing
packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-c.description: Builds per-occurrence nonces and folds unstarted catch-up ticks of the same routine into one queued run.

packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-f.name: Failure auto-pause
packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-f.description: Pauses a routine after five identical consecutive failures and posts the reason in its chat.

packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-b.name: Account error backoff
packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-b.description: Pushes a routine's next run out with doubling gaps when the model account is refused, and releases it on reconnect.

packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-l.name: Late run detection
packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-l.description: Finds the occurrence a recurring run was due at when it started at least 15 minutes late.

packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-l.name: Late run instruction
packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-l.description: Tells a late scheduled run when it was due and when it started, in the routine's timezone.

packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-r.name: Routine run instruction
packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-r.description: Builds the instruction telling a scheduled run to do the work now and not reschedule itself.

packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-c.name: Due task handover
packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-c.description: Builds the prompt that hands a due scheduled task to the run already working in its chat.

packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-w.name: Watch change note
packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-w.description: Builds the note appended to a routine prompt saying what changed since the last check.

packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-w.name: Change watch checker
packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-w.description: Fingerprints files, commands, tools or HTTPS endpoints without a model and starts a run only when the reading changed.

packages/contracts/src/routines/routine-.name: Watch contract
packages/contracts/src/routines/routine-.description: Defines the watch spec, five-minute minimum interval, quiet-check flag and stored last-check state.

packages/adapters/src/routines/strategic.name: Check-in prompt
packages/adapters/src/routines/strategic.description: Builds the daily check-in prompt listing stale items and demanding NO_RESPONSE when nothing needs action.

packages/adapters/src/routines/release-w.name: Release watch eval
packages/adapters/src/routines/release-w.description: Provides emulated GitHub releases and diagnoses for the release-watch eval, not a runtime feature.

packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-e.name: Routine end dates
packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-e.description: Computes end-date rules and deletes or ends routines that pass their end or finish a one-time run.

packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-n.name: Routine change notice
packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-n.description: Posts a text-free routine_event system row in the chat when a routine is created, edited or deleted.

packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-t.name: Routine chat target
packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-t.description: Picks the group chat a routine runs in, or the bot's own chat when the group is gone.

packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-t.name: Schedule tool target
packages/adapters/src/routines/routine-t.description: Resolves whose routines a schedule tool call reaches, the bot's own or a managed bot's.

packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.name: Run notifications
packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.description: Decides who gets a push or chat alert for a finished or failed run, honoring snooze and per-routine notify.

packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/cha.name: Chat busy wait
packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/cha.description: Holds scheduled and bot-message runs while their chat is busy and hands a due routine to the working run.

packages/core/src/runs/action-approval.t.name: Action approval rules
packages/core/src/runs/action-approval.t.description: Lists tools needing approval, gates outside-text runs, and expires unattended approval cards after a timeout.

packages/adapters/src/approvals/approval.name: Approval card expiry
packages/adapters/src/approvals/approval.description: Schedules and applies the auto-deny of an unanswered approval card from an unattended run.

apps/api/src/webhooks/webhook.ts.name: Webhook route
apps/api/src/webhooks/webhook.ts.description: Authenticates a bot webhook by key or signature and delivers it to the bot's webhook-enabled routines.

apps/api/src/webhooks/webhook-inbound.ts.name: Inbound delivery
apps/api/src/webhooks/webhook-inbound.ts.description: Loads the webhook target, builds the routine-plus-payload prompt and starts a webhook-trigger run.

apps/api/src/email/email-inbound.ts.name: Inbound email
apps/api/src/email/email-inbound.ts.description: Checks sender authenticity, stores mail in the bot inbox and starts matching email routines or an owner message.

apps/api/src/messaging/messaging-inbound.name: Inbound chat messages
apps/api/src/messaging/messaging-inbound.description: Wakes message-trigger routines from a linked chat app through the webhook delivery path.

apps/api/src/routes/routines.ts.name: Routines RPC handlers
apps/api/src/routes/routines.ts.description: Serves routine list, history, create, update, delete and test run over RPC with owner-only edits.

apps/api/src/routines/routine-runs.ts.name: Routine run history
apps/api/src/routines/routine-runs.ts.description: Lists a routine's past runs with status, error, lateness and the first reply message.

packages/contracts/src/routines/routines.name: Routines RPC contract
packages/contracts/src/routines/routines.description: Declares the routine list, history, create, update, remove and testRun calls and their inputs.

packages/core/src/routines/routine-runs..name: Run history helpers
packages/core/src/routines/routine-runs..description: Formats routine run times, lateness and merges history pages for clients.

packages/core/src/routines/inbound-routi.name: Inbound routine blocks
packages/core/src/routines/inbound-routi.description: Formats and parses the owner's routine prompt blocks that precede untrusted inbound payload text.

packages/core/src/routines/routine-dispa.name: Schedule delay check
packages/core/src/routines/routine-dispa.description: Flags a routine whose next run is more than five minutes stale.

packages/adapters/src/cloud-agents/cloud.name: Cloud agent poller
packages/adapters/src/cloud-agents/cloud.description: Polls a remote cloud agent under a lease and wakes the originating run when it changes.

packages/db/src/threads/thread-reads.ts.name: Thread read state
packages/db/src/threads/thread-reads.ts.description: Reads per-thread read state, including which members have a chat snoozed.

packages/db/src/billing/billing.ts.name: Billing access
packages/db/src/billing/billing.ts.description: Decides whether a Space member's plan allows model use.
